rulebook.title: FIVB Official Volleyball Rules 2025-2028 (approved by the 39th FIVB World Congress 2024)
rulebook.text_used: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jarkko/beach-volleyball-rules-fi/HEAD/corpus/english/FIVB-Volleyball_Rules2025_2028-EN-v05.txt (English text mirror, not checked against fivb.com)

net_height_m.note: measured at mid-court, no more than 2 cm above

side_bands_m.note: white, directly above each side line

antenna_m.note: red and white stripes, part of the net

scene.text: Six players per team on court, three front row and three back row.
At most one Libero on court, in a jersey of a clearly contrasting dominant colour; the Libero never serves, blocks or attacks a ball entirely above the net.
Jersey numbers 1-20 centred on the chest (at least 15 cm tall) and back (at least 20 cm tall); the captain has an 8 x 2 cm stripe under the chest number.
Team members wear the same jersey, shorts and socks (Libero excepted); shoes without heels.
Red-and-white striped antennae stand 80 cm above the net at each side line; the net is black 10 cm mesh with a 7 cm white top band.
Court 18 x 9 m, white 5 cm lines; the centre line runs under the net and attack lines are 3 m from it on both sides.
First referee stands on a referee's stand at one end of the net, eyes about 50 cm above the net; the second referee stands on the floor near the opposite post.
Line judges with flags stand in the free zone 1-3 m from the court corners.

fouls.title: Touching the net
fouls.text: Contact with the net between the antennae (or with the antenna) during the action of playing the ball, from take-off to landing, is a fault.
fouls.legal: no part of the body touches the net or the antennae
avoid: hand or arm pressing into the net mesh

fouls.title: Crossing the centre line
fouls.text: Touching the opponent's court with a foot is allowed only if part of the foot stays on or directly above the centre line; a foot completely in the opponent's court is a fault.
fouls.legal: neither foot is completely past the centre line
avoid: foot planted on the opponent's side under the net

fouls.title: Attack hit in the opponent's space
fouls.text: The attack hit must start within the attacker's own playing space; the hand may pass beyond the net only after the initial contact.
fouls.legal: the ball is struck on the attacker's own side of the net
avoid: spiker reaching over the net to hit the ball on the opponent's side

fouls.title: Block above the net
fouls.text: Only front-row players may complete a block, and at the moment of contact part of the body must be higher than the top of the net.
fouls.legal: the hands are above the top of the net
avoid: blocker's hands below the net tape

fouls.title: Blocking beyond the net
fouls.text: A blocker may touch the ball beyond the net only after the opponent's attack hit; reaching over is otherwise interference.
fouls.legal: the blocker reaches over the net only against the opponent's attack hit

fouls.title: Catch or throw
fouls.text: The ball must be hit, not caught or thrown; it rebounds from the contact.
fouls.legal: the ball rebounds from a brief contact, it is not caught or held
avoid: ball held or cradled in the hands

fouls.title: Double contact
fouls.text: Several body parts may touch the ball only at the same time (except on the block and the team's first hit).
fouls.legal: both hands meet the ball at the same instant
avoid: one hand touching the ball before the other

fouls.title: Libero restrictions
fouls.text: A Libero may not serve, block or attempt to block, nor complete an attack hit with the ball entirely above the net; a front-zone overhand finger pass by the Libero may not be attacked above the net.
fouls.legal: the player is not the Libero (different jersey colour)

fouls.title: Back-row attack
fouls.text: A back-row player attacking a ball entirely above the net must take off behind the attack line (3 m) and may land in the front zone.
